newsitem.title: USA: Whirlpool sees lower Q3 operating results.
newsitem.headline: Whirlpool sees lower Q3 operating results.

text.p: Whirlpool Corp said Friday it expects third quarter operating results, excluding restructuring charges, to be down 35-40 percent from a year earlier.
The company also said it had lowered its expectations for the full year.
Whirlpool said it will take a $30 million restructuring charge in the third quarter for the previously announced streamlining of its Asian headquarters and a North American refrigeration operation.

Whirlpool, which makes major home appliances, said its less favorable outlook for the third quarter was caused primarily by conditions in Europe, its second largest regional market. It said a continued difficult economic and industry environment is contributing to a lack of margin improvement.
While third-quarter results will be significantly better than those of the second quarter, it will have a small quarterly operating loss at Whirlpool Europe.
Whirlpool reported an operating loss in Europe in the second quarter, when it earned $0.70 a share overall.

In a statement, Whirlpool Chairman David Whitwam said year-to-date results from the company's North American and Latin American operations are at record high levels. He said both regions are expected to perform strongly through the rest of the year.
Whirlpool said it expects to report its third quarter results on October 21.
